description: This file contains utility functions for validating and formatting phone numbers using the 'libphonenumber-js' library. It provides functions to validate, format for display, and format for storage, tailored for international and common country code handling.

methods.name: validatePhoneNumber(phoneNumber, defaultCountry)
methods.description: Validates a phone number string, optionally using a default country code, and returns an object indicating validity, formatted number if valid, or error message.

methods.name: formatPhoneNumber(phoneNumber, defaultCountry = 'US')
methods.description: Formats a phone number for display in international format, defaulting to 'US' if no default is provided.

methods.name: formatPhoneForStorage(phoneNumber, defaultCountry)
methods.description: Formats a phone number into E.164 format for storage purposes, trying with the provided default country and common countries if necessary.
